illustrations.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a conceptual illustration for a university AI lecture about asking informative questions, inspired by the twenty-questions idea used by Akinator. Primary request: a friendly original question-asking character, a small brass-and-forest-green mechanical owl, holds up a pale card with the exact question 'Fictional?'. A group of six tiny original character cards separates into two smaller groups along two clear paths labeled exactly 'Yes' and 'No'. Show a human silhouette, an astronaut, and a scientist on the No side; a tiny dragon, a robot knight, and a friendly ghost on the Yes side. This is an analogy for narrowing possibilities, not a real product screenshot or an algorithm diagram. White background, clean restrained educational editorial illustration, charcoal outlines, forest green #154734, muted gold #BD8B13, pale mint and warm beige, generous white space. Compact landscape 3:2 composition, readable at 3 inches wide. Text only 'Fictional?', 'Yes', 'No'. No logos, no Akinator branding, no equations, no extraneous headings, no watermark.

model_figures: California Housing and Wine models use all records to illustrate structure, not to estimate held-out performance. Slide images show the top two levels; *_full.png files preserve all four fitted levels.
evaluation: Independent synthetic make_moons experiment uses separate training, validation, and final test partitions. Data, seeds, pruning parameters, and measured scores appear in generate-charts.py and chart-checks.json.
